item.description: MARSHALL COUNTY, W.Va. (WTRF) - Recently, the Marshall County Commission awarded over $93,000 in opioid settlement funds through their first-ever non-profit grant program. Three local organizations received funding including $48,310 to the Marshall County Family Resource Network, $25,000 to The Unity Center in Benwood, and $20,000 to the Marshall County Schools Drug Free Clubs. item.title: Moundsville Council passes storm water rate increase, residents will see bill rise
item.description: Moundsville, W.Va. (WTRF) - The City of Moundsville passed an ordinance to increase the storm water rate fees. The fee for residential users was increased from $5 to $8, which is the first-ever increase for residential users since the program began in 2010.
